build.environment: Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS under WSL, TeX Live 2023, pdfTeX 1.40.25, latexmk 4.83, Poppler 24.02.0
build.result: Two clean builds from the extracted source ZIP produced byte-identical PDFs with no final LaTeX or layout warnings. Inspected PNG renders of every page and checked that the title and abstract agree with the metadata.

endpoint_minima.result: Five million four hundred seventy-five thousand two hundred eight minima through dimension 200, including 2,145 ordinary-forcing signatures. All 1,188 dimension-30 minima and a brute endpoint test on 401 signatures through dimension 20 agree.

full_historical_counts.result: An integral-breakpoint enumeration reproduced all 1,188 historical rows, including 8,073,364 candidate polygons, 3,846,011 surviving polygons, and the minimum p-ranks.

moment_covers.result: The former replays three rational residues, the split p=19 case, and 69 bounded branch multisets across 20 combinations. The latter checks the split nonordinary p=73 selection and connected-conductor examples at 37 in orders 342, 12,663 and 468,540.

pfaffian_curve.result: Recomputed the genus-four cyclic covering character counts and relative Frobenius quartics at 7 and 13, checked ordinary middle coefficients and the S4 factorization witnesses, distinguished the two absolute Frobenius fields by splitting at 2, and verified the ordinary reduction at the inert prime 11. The article supplies the specialization argument from these certificates to the geometric endomorphism ring.

replay_scope: All five commands were executed from the archived supplement in Python 3.12.3 or PARI/GP 2.15.4. The programs check the stated finite examples. The adjoint and CM norm results, twelvefold construction, and fourfold density theorem use written arguments.

pdf_only_internal_review.context: The complete text extracted from the compiled PDF, selected rendered pages, and the five neutral reader prompts. The final reader received rendered pages 1, 7, 9, 10, 19 and 24. No repository material or previous conversation was supplied, and the reviewers made no tool calls.
findings: Recovered the factorwise adjoint bound, the original-field balanced fourfold theorem, the simultaneous CM coefficient bounds and the sharp numerical p-rank formula. Distinguished the known unbalanced case of the fourfold density theorem from its balanced extension.

Explained the weighted lost-pole argument and the Pfaffian parity argument on the interchanging components. Identified the twelvefold as a two-active example for which the split CM inequalities permit a nonordinary polygon.

Located the projected Kottwitz class comparison in Section 2.2 and the lattice determinant and Pfaffian calculation in Section 4.2 as the hardest steps. Reconstructed the displayed local and global bounds without finding an internal contradiction.

Distinguished finite-extension density, original-field density in the balanced fourfold case, numerical sharpness and the unresolved independent split cubic case. The specialist review points are the precise tensor comparison and monodromy inputs, the Pfaffian lattice comparison and the arithmetic realization of the twelvefold.

The reader could reconstruct the finite fourfold certificate from its printed data. Execution of the supplement and the polygon counts was checked separately. The reader suggested displaying the compositum K tau(E) explicitly in the unbalanced endomorphism-field identification; the notation KE in the draft means that compositum.
pdf_only_internal_review.revisions_and_rechecks: The Hui bibliography entry was recomposed between candidate and final for a warning-free build. Both reviews recovered the scope and proof mechanism of the new fourfold result and the twelvefold example.

remaining: Specialist review of the tensor comparison, adjoint and Pfaffian arguments, the corestriction realization over a number field, the numerical minima, and priority.
Density of one flat active factor at completely split primes with three independent active labels in the cubic real multiplication case.
